Develop lightweight API layers that allow Agritech and Insurtech firms to integrate directly into EcoCash/OneMoney USSD menus. Since data costs remain a barrier to app adoption, "offline-first" functionality is the primary lever for scaling services to the 90%+ mobile-penetrated population.
